# Best MagSafe car mounts (as of Oct 2026)

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, $47.99**
- Includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, so nothing extra to buy.
- Rotates between portrait and landscape and takes cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent slats need to be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Vertical or shallow vents may droop.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest charging and best cooling: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99**
- Qi2 25W with thermoelectric cooling and a fan, which helps when navigation is running in the sun.
- 25W works on the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, and anything older is generally 15W.
- Not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents, and the iPhone 16e isn't supported.
- Sources disagree on the adapter. The Gadgeteer and Mount Guys say a 60W adapter is in the box, while other reviews say you need a 45W+ car adapter. Check the listing before you buy.
- The Gadgeteer listed it at $69.99 (down from $89.99), so check the current price.
- Mount Guys uses it as their own daily driver. Sources: [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- Qi2-certified 15W, with a fan to prevent throttling, and it fits a vent or a 3M dash mount.
- Prices in the sources vary a lot ($18.99 to $39.99), and it's unclear whether a car adapter is included. Assume you may need to buy one.
- ESR's US store lists it at $39.99, and one coupon site says code PARTNER18 takes $7.19 off (to about $32.80) through 2026-12-31. [Buy at ESR (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, from $39.95:** The Gadgeteer's top pick, with a 95W adapter included. It has a large suction base.
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99:** 15W, with an NFC Shortcuts trigger. It has no fan, so it may throttle on hot dashboards.
- **Non-charging VICSEED steel-core vent mount:** A simpler backup if you don't need charging.

Mount Guys notes that "MagSafe-compatible" without a Qi2 badge may only charge at 7.5W. For the full speeds above, use a USB-C PD car charger of the wattage each mount calls for.

I couldn't open the Amazon listings directly, so for everything except ESR the links go to the review pages, which have the Amazon buttons. If you tell me your phone model and vent or dash layout, I can narrow this down.
